exposure: women with CVD delivering at term
women with CVD delivering early term
finding: Early term delivery in women with CVD was not associated with improved maternal cardiac outcomes compared to term delivery.
mod_finding: Women with cardiovascular disease who delivered in the early term period were more likely to undergo cesarean delivery.
gest_age: 37(0/7) through 38(6/7) weeks (early term) and 39 weeks or later (term)
